scope: Proposition 5.1 of the manuscript “Log abundance in characteristic zero” (preprints/Log-abundance-in-characteristic-zero-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 87b191f75e8c8526), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume the transition surjectivity of Proposition 4.1. There is a dominating algebraic family of integral projective subvarieties of X of dimension d = n − 1 − r = n − v whose general members avoid D and on which L is numerically trivial.
